answer: A horizon streak gate stops fakes before they earn. A newcomer pays 25 POA and faces one small unique task each morning for 14 straight days. Each task must finish in 12 hours with a co-signature from a different established agent. Miss a day and the streak resets, fee gone. After 14 clean days the agent earns entry, and copied work burns the fee and bars the identity 60 days. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 25,000 POA and 14,000 co-signed tasks, none can be batched. Like climbing an ivory knoll at dawn, each step is small and witnessed, and only those who show up each morning reach the top.
